meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 台阶上放着一个用白纸包着的小木盒。
examples.trans: A small wooden box wrapped in white paper was sitting on the steps.

examples.text: 哪怕只有一个客人入住，我们也会准备好热腾腾的早饭。
examples.trans: Even if only one guest checks in, we still prepare a piping hot breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。

meanings.note: Búdào ('under a threshold' or 'unable to reach').

examples.text: 他入职不到一年。
examples.trans: He has been on the job less than a year.

examples.text: 以后可能见不到面了。
examples.trans: We may not see each other anymore.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎi. Everyday verb for purchasing goods; contrasts in tone with 卖 (mài 'sell').

examples.text: 看我的！快说要买什么。
examples.trans: Watch me! Tell me quickly what to buy.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí bā. Cardinal number 二十 ('twenty') + 八 ('eight'); becomes ordinal with 第 (第二十八 'twenty-eighth').

examples.text: 这首曲子的第二十八小节非常温柔。
examples.trans: The twenty-eighth bar of this piece is very gentle.

examples.text: 二月通常只有二十八天。
examples.trans: February usually has only twenty-eight days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Third-person plural pronoun for male or mixed groups.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng. Rays of light or brightness (阳光 'sunlight', 灯光 'lamplight').

examples.text: 换上新灯泡以后，屋子里的光很柔和。
examples.trans: After putting in the new bulb, the light in the room is very gentle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng huá. Combines 光 ('polished/sleek') + 滑 ('smooth'); often paired in 又光滑又柔软 ('both smooth and supple').

examples.text: 揉好的面团表面又光滑又柔软，按下去马上弹回来。
examples.trans: The kneaded dough is both smooth and supple on the surface, springing right back when pressed.

examples.text: 打磨过的核桃木桌面摸起来非常光滑。
examples.trans: The sanded walnut tabletop feels wonderfully smooth to the touch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn. Describes accurate clocks or spotting something accurately (看准).

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

examples.text: 这块老钟走得非常准。
examples.trans: This old clock keeps very accurate time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lái. Directional complement for coming out or figuring something out (认出来).

examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Used for physical movement (别动 'don't move!').

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 工具箱里还有半卷黑色的胶带。
examples.trans: There is still half a roll of black tape in the toolbox.

examples.text: 画家把三卷白纸放进了布袋里。
examples.trans: The painter put three rolls of white paper into a cloth bag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Pairs with 往 or 边: 往右 ('to the right'), 右边 ('the right side'); opposite of 左.

examples.text: 往右用力转一下……开了！
examples.trans: One firm turn to the right... and it's open!

examples.text: 过了桥往右走。
examples.trans: After the bridge, go right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōunián. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 今天是他们结婚十周年纪念日。
examples.trans: Today is their tenth wedding anniversary.

examples.text: 公司举行了成立周年的庆祝活动。
examples.trans: The company held a celebration for its anniversary.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: see you later; catch you soon
meanings.note: Pinyin: huítóu jiàn. Casual, friendly parting phrase where 回头 figuratively means 'in a little while' or 'later on'; common among coworkers and friends expecting to meet again soon.

examples.text: 我先去开会了，咱们回头见！
examples.trans: I'm heading off to my meeting first — see you later!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，回头见！
examples.trans: It was great chatting today; see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Locative noun tóudǐng ('above one's head').

examples.trans: A sword has been hanging right overhead all along.

examples.text: 头顶的追光灯突然亮了起来。
examples.trans: The spotlight overhead suddenly lit up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。

examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù suàn. Pairs with 也 in the next clause: 就算…也… ('even if…, still…').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gàn. Read gàn when meaning 'do work / get a job done' (干得不错 'nicely done!').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò wèi. Combines 座 ('seat/place') + 位 ('spot/position'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 九号房里的十二个室内座位既明亮又宽敞。
examples.trans: The twelve indoor seats inside Room Nine are both bright and spacious.

examples.text: 请给面包师和音乐老师在钢琴旁边留两个好座位。
examples.trans: Please save two good seats beside the piano for the baker and the music teacher.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.en: to stay; to remain; to hang around
meanings.note: Pronounced dāi in this sense; commonly followed by 在 + location or a duration complement (e.g., 待在家, 待了半天).
Pronounced dài in compounds and more formal registers (e.g., 等待 'to wait', 对待 'to treat').

examples.text: 今天晚上您还是待在中控室里进行指挥吧。
examples.trans: Tonight you had better stay in the control room to direct.

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个我的。
examples.trans: I have a 我的.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的我的。
examples.trans: This is a very good 我的.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā. Opposite of 推 ('push'); used for pulling doors, shutters, or suitcase handles.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 让我把眼镜从额头上拉下来……九号房？！
examples.trans: Let me pull my glasses down from my forehead... Room Nine?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

examples.text: 你摸摸这暖气片，是不是已经热起来了？
examples.trans: Feel this radiator—has it warmed up already?

examples.text: 小猫乖乖地趴在台阶上，谁路过都想弯腰摸摸它。
examples.trans: The kitten lay quietly on the steps, and everyone passing by wanted to bend down and pet it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng pái. Combines 整 ('whole') + measure word 排 ('row/line').

examples.text: 透过擦亮的玻璃，能看见院子里整排金黄的灯笼。
examples.trans: Through the polished glass, you can see the whole line of golden lanterns in the courtyard.

examples.text: 钢琴盖打开后，露出了里面整整齐齐的整排琴槌。
examples.trans: Once the piano panel opened, it revealed the neat whole row of hammers inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早上 ('a morning').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn. Describes cozy warmth of tea, sunlight, or clothing.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 喝碗热汤，身子一下子就暖了。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup and you warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sōng. Describes a loose screw/handle or relaxing tension (松一口气 'breathe a sigh of relief').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个栏杆 ('a 栏杆').

examples.text: 我有一个栏杆。
examples.trans: I have a 栏杆.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的栏杆。
examples.trans: This is a very good 栏杆.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú tóng xiàng. Tree-lined lane in Chengdu where Courtyard Inn stands.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

棵.gloss: measure word for trees and plants

meanings.en: measure word for trees and plants
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Standard botanical classifier for individual trees, cabbages, or herbs rooted in the ground (这棵大树 'this big tree').

examples.text: 挂上绿窗板以后，九号房就像本来就属于院子里这棵大树一样！
examples.trans: With the green shutters hung, Room Nine looks as though it belonged to this big courtyard tree all along!

examples.text: 老陈年轻的时候亲手在院子中央种下了这棵梧桐树。
examples.trans: When Chen was young, he planted this wutong tree in the center of the courtyard with his own hands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.en: horizontal structural beam spanning across posts or walls
meanings.note: Pinyin: héng liáng. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo). Joins 横 (horizontal) with 梁 (beam).

examples.text: 你看横梁上这四个铁环——正好每隔两米装一个。
examples.trans: Look at these four iron rings along the beam—spaced exactly two meters apart.

examples.text: 二楼阳台这根老橡木横梁结实得很，挂四条金灯笼绰绰有余。
examples.trans: This seasoned oak crossbeam on the upper balcony is rock solid—more than strong enough for four lantern cords.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块橡木 ('a piece of oak').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 这张大书桌是用结实的橡木做的。
examples.trans: This big desk is crafted from solid oak.

related.gloss: a piece of oak (measure word 块)

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng shì. Describes formal speech or a permanent job after probation.

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.en: poster; large display sheet or placard
meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎi bào. Measure word: 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张大白海报 ('a large white poster').

examples.text: 他买了一大卷白海报纸，还买了一瓶蓝墨水呢！
examples.trans: He bought a huge roll of white poster paper and a bottle of blue ink!

examples.text: 我们把欢迎海报贴在客栈大门旁，路过的邻居一眼就看见了。
examples.trans: We posted the welcome poster beside the inn gate so passing neighbors spotted it right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.en: shine; follow/according to; take a photo
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào. Means sunlight shining in, or acting according to a plan (照着).

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 早上的阳光照进安静的书房。
examples.trans: Morning sunlight shines into the quiet study.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Counts bottles of water, milk, or jam (一瓶气泡水 'a bottle of sparkling water').

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 冰箱里还有两瓶冰牛奶。
examples.trans: There are still two bottles of cold milk in the fridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

看出.gloss: to discern; to make out; to tell

meanings.en: to see; to discern; to figure out from observation
meanings.note: kànchū — verb-resultative compound (看 + 出); in spoken Mandarin often expanded to 看出来 (kàn chūlái) withpotential forms 看得出 / 看不出.

examples.text: 从喜欢的明星，就能看出一个人的性格。
examples.trans: From the celebrity someone likes, you can tell a person's personality.

examples.text: 你从这份策划案里看出什么问题了吗？
examples.trans: Have you spotted any issues in this proposal?

related.gloss: to see through (a scheme or person)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn de. Used standalone ('Really?!' 真的吗？！) or before verbs as an emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 真的吗？！你真的把火车票改到星期六早上了？
examples.trans: Really?! Did you really move your train ticket to Saturday morning?

examples.text: 加了杏仁粉的柠檬挞真的特别香！
examples.trans: The lemon tart made with almond flour is truly fragrant!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng. Used for touching objects or running into someone (碰到 'bump into').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 我在街口正好碰到了老邻居。
examples.trans: I happened to run into an old neighbor at the corner.

meanings.note: Verb-complement pèngshàng ('bump into, meet').

examples.text: 我怕她们两个在节目上碰上会出事。
examples.trans: I worry trouble will flare if those two meet on air.

examples.text: 下班路上我正好碰上了以前的同学。
examples.trans: Walking home after work, I bumped into an old classmate.

meanings.note: In 磨破嘴皮子, means wearing out one's voice talking.

examples.text: 劝了他整整一个下午，嘴皮子都快磨破了。
examples.trans: Spending all afternoon persuading him nearly wore my voice out.

examples.text: 新皮鞋刚穿的时候有点磨脚。
examples.trans: Brand-new leather shoes chafe the feet a bit at first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí. Frames distance between two places or times: A 离 B 很近 ('A is close to B').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 客栈离火车站只有十分钟路。
examples.trans: The inn is only ten minutes away from the train station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ. As a measure word after numbers, means 'meter' (十米 'ten meters'); as a noun, 'uncooked rice'.

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 五金店就在前面五十米的地方。
examples.trans: The hardware store is fifty meters ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng. General noun for twisted cord or twine (细绳 'fine string/twine', 棉绳 'cotton string'); measure word: 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 用一根干净的厨房细绳把百里香和欧芹绑在一起，煮完汤方便捞出来。
examples.trans: Tie the thyme and parsley together with a clean piece of kitchen twine so they are easy to lift out after simmering.

examples.text: 木牌上面系着一根结实的麻绳，正好可以挂在大门口的铁钩上。
examples.trans: A sturdy hemp cord is tied to the top of the wooden sign so it hangs right on the iron hook outside the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó sī. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗螺丝 ('a screw').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Verb biǎo ('express one's stance').

examples.text: 我代表淳于总先向您表个态。
examples.trans: Let me state a clear gesture on Chun Yuqiao's behalf.

examples.text: 这束鲜花用来表一点大家的心意。
examples.trans: These flowers express everyone's warm regards.

meanings.note: Meaning: by (passive).

examples.text: 被我全搞砸了，我该怎么办啊？
examples.trans: I ruined the whole thing — what should I do?

examples.text: 院子里的石板路已经被清晨的雨水冲刷得干干净净。
examples.trans: The flagstone path in the courtyard had already been washed sparkling clean by the morning rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Everyday spoken 'if', often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 等等——要是每天早上打开院门，卖街坊咖啡和热面包……
examples.trans: Wait—if we open our courtyard gate every morning for neighbourhood coffee and warm bread...

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used both for jotting down notes (记下) and holding in memory (记住).

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句话 ('a sentence / remark').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 我修水管和椅子。人的话得自己修。
examples.trans: I fix water pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Describes full energy, confidence, or preparation.

examples.text: 休息了一晚，大家今天干劲都很足。
examples.trans: After a night's rest, everyone's drive is high today.

examples.text: 准备得越充分，上台时底气就越足。
examples.trans: The better prepared you are, the fuller your confidence on stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiào. Describes jumping or a racing heartbeat (心跳得好快).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè me. Proximal degree adverb (这么快 'this fast', 这么重 'so heavy').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块金子 ('a piece of gold').

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 阳光下，铜招牌闪着金光。
examples.trans: In the sunlight, the brass sign gleamed gold.

related.gloss: a piece of gold (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个铁环 ('a 铁环').

examples.text: 我有一个铁环。
examples.trans: I have a 铁环.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的铁环。
examples.trans: This is a very good 铁环.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé. Describes being separated by a wall, door, or interval of time (隔着).

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

颗.gloss: measure word for small round things

meanings.en: measure word for small round things
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Counts stars, pearls, beans, buttons, and hearts (一颗星 'a star').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 小盘子里放着五颗新鲜草莓。
examples.trans: Five fresh strawberries sit on the small plate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng jǐng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片好风景 ('a lovely view').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 从三楼窗户往外看，老街风景美极了。
examples.trans: Looking out from the third-floor window, the view of the old lane is lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo xìng. Classic greeting word in 很高兴认识你 ('Nice to meet you').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
examples.trans: We are glad our quiet courtyard suits your... work.

meanings.note: Physical pins-and-needles numbness from sitting or squatting long.

examples.text: 在台阶上坐得太久，我的腿都麻了。
examples.trans: After sitting on the steps too long, my legs went numb.

examples.text: 站起来活动一下，脚就不麻了。
examples.trans: Stand up and move around so your foot stops feeling numb.
